Dear Inventory Associate,

We welcome you to your first working day. Your shift begins as soon as you launch the application light.exe.

Your duty is the storage of all units in their designated collection basins.

Your shift ends when the rest period begins. Proceed to your workstation at that time. Equipment may be acquired there; costs will be offset against your remuneration.

Do not leave the break room during the rest period.

At the end of each rest period, launch the application light.exe.

Kind regards,
Wendberger, Shift Supervision

Playrooms Inc.
We are always there for you.

Dear Inventory Associate,

During your probation period, some areas of the building remain locked to you. You will receive the keys with your permanent employment.

If you wish to continue working with us: the remaining areas are now open. You can take up your permanent position on Steam.

Kind regards,
Wendberger, Shift Supervision

We have recently received several complaints from your colleagues about so-called "anomalies" and "sightings".

Your wellbeing is very important to us. That is why we installed an update on your computer tonight: report.exe.

Should you notice anything unusual, simply send us a report whenever you feel the need. Every report is evaluated immediately.

Until then, please continue working as usual.
